softwareValidation.note: The branch has changed after the last fully green checkpoint and must be revalidated before release. Automated WebKit/iPhone evidence is not physical-device acceptance.

internalTrainerMedia.scope: Paradise employee/internal training only; preserve REFERENCE/HISTORICAL authority labels and do not treat trainer media as current Paradise policy.
internalTrainerMedia.note: Internal-use treatment is a project operating choice, not a legal opinion. Media-rights documentation is not a Paradise University release gate under the current project scope.

physicalDeviceAcceptance.requiredEvidence: Completed docs/PARADISE_UNIVERSITY_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE.md record on an actual iPhone for Safari and installed Home Screen PWA, including offline behavior and actual internal audio/video playback.

humanCurriculumComplianceReview.requiredEvidence: Named human reviewer(s), date, exact candidate commit, and disposition covering curriculum accuracy, Paradise policy boundaries, field-authority separation, and sales procedure holds.

promotionAuthorization.requiredEvidence: Explicit authorization to advance the validated branch after all other gates are PASS.

validatedBranchReadback.requiredEvidence: After authorized promotion, read back validated branch commit, dataset SHA, 78/76/2 guards, and operational URL behavior before calling the release live.

hardRule: A green software validator is necessary but not sufficient for release. Current blockers are physical-device acceptance, human curriculum/compliance review, and explicit promotion authorization; internal trainer-media rights are not a release blocker under the current project scope.
